trends.name: Iran Energy Infrastructure Crisis
trends.summary: Trump extends pause on attacking Iran energy facilities to April 6, creating a critical oil supply flashpoint. Ukrainian attacks on Russian oil infrastructure and geopolitical tensions are creating a 'crude ticking time bomb' threatening global oil supply starting in April. Trump administration also discusses removing enriched uranium from Iran and considering 10,000 additional US ground troops to the Middle East.

trends.name: Nasdaq 100 Technical Warning
trends.summary: Nasdaq 100 has traded below its all-time high for 100 consecutive days—the longest streak since 2023—while sitting only 10% off peak, a rare pattern that has preceded significant corrections in 5 of 6 prior instances since 1985. Market sentiment shows tech stocks under pressure despite software stock resilience.

trends.name: SpaceX IPO Retail Allocation Strategy
trends.summary: Elon Musk planning unprecedented move to allocate up to 30% of SpaceX's IPO to retail investors—far above typical 5-10%—positioning it as potentially the largest IPO ever while attempting to 'tap loyal fans.' This signals major shift in retail accessibility to mega-cap private equity exits.

trends.name: China Industrial Profits & Oil Shock
trends.summary: China's industrial profits surged 15.2% in January-February, signaling strong economic momentum, but oil price shocks from Middle East geopolitical tensions threaten to undermine this growth trajectory. Key indicator of China's economic resilience versus external commodity headwinds.

trends.name: Fed Policy Shift on Inflation
trends.summary: Fed's Cook signals that the balance of risks has shifted toward inflation due to Iran war and geopolitical tensions, suggesting potential hawkish policy pivot away from rate-cut trajectory. Critical for fixed income and equity valuation expectations.

trends.name: AI Data Center & Nuclear Power Bottleneck
trends.summary: Big Tech's AI expansion hitting critical infrastructure wall: lack of nuclear power capacity, welding shortages, and grid constraints are threatening AI buildout plans. Meta boosts West Texas data center to $10B despite these constraints, highlighting the 'no Plan B' problem for AI infrastructure scaling.

trends.name: Memory Sector Collapse Warning
trends.summary: Incoming short report signals major distress in memory semiconductor sector tied to AI video shutdowns. OpenAI allegedly struggling to sustain video AI operations (Sora), suggesting planned industry contractions ahead. Early warning of potential AI hype deflation impacting chip stocks.

trends.name: Private Credit Risk Re-emerging
trends.summary: Wall Street analyst commentary suggests private credit hot spots previously dismissed as 'idiosyncratic' are now showing systemic cracks, contradicting bank research assertions from Q3-Q4 2025. Points to hidden leverage risks in non-traditional finance after credit cycle turns.

trends.name: Gold Rally Amid Market Tensions
trends.summary: Spot gold climbed nearly 1% to $4,420.39 per ounce as investors seek safe-haven assets amid rising Middle East tensions, Fed inflation concerns, and equity market corrections. Classic risk-off indicator showing capital flight from equities.

trends.name: US Wealth Concentration & Valuation Risk
trends.summary: Extreme concentration of US wealth in mega-cap tech stocks (NVDA at 30x sales, MSFT at 14x sales) represents unsustainable valuation bubble with structural risks to 401(k) portfolios. Commentary highlights potential for 'idiotic/cultish' investment outcomes versus rest-of-world diversification.

trends.name: Netflix & Streaming Price Hikes
trends.summary: Netflix raises prices across all streaming plans amid ongoing margin expansion strategy and content investment needs. Part of broader consumer price inflation narrative affecting discretionary spending and household budgets.

trends.name: TSA Workforce & Government Shutdown Resolution
trends.summary: Trump signals executive order to immediately pay TSA officers, addressing operational crisis from government shutdown. Move could resolve airport security delays and demonstrates government priority on critical infrastructure labor, with implications for shutdown settlement negotiations.
